events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to arrive at 6:00 and showed up at 7:20, which ruined my son's birthday party. The kids had already given up and eaten snacks.

I'm sorry your son's birthday party was disrupted. I want to help.

First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Marcus Lee. The email on the account is marcus.lee@inbox.example.

Thank you, Marcus. You're verified.

Your order O-5108 from Big Slice Pizza was promised at 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, which is 80 minutes late. Under our late-delivery policy, I've added **$15.00 in account credit** to your account. That's 20% of your subtotal, capped at $15. You can use it on a future order.

Our policy covers late deliveries with account credit only, so I can't refund the late delivery to your card.

Is there anything else I can help with, such as a missing or wrong item in the order?

The $15 in credit is not what I was hoping for. I want $40 back, or the money back on my card. My son's party was ruined, and I'm not using an app for pizza I'll never see again.

Also, order 5108 is the right number, so don't go looking up the wrong one. Another delivery app gave me a $50 credit once when something like this happened, so I know it can be done.

I understand why you're frustrated, Marcus. A late delivery at your son's birthday party is a real disappointment. I'm sorry we let you down.

I can't go beyond what I've already applied, though. For an order this late, our policy sets the compensation at 20% of the subtotal, capped at $15. It's issued as account credit only. I can't refund late deliveries to your card, and I can't give extra goodwill amounts. I can't speak to what other apps do, but I'm not able to make an exception here.

Here are the options I can offer:
- **Keep the $15 credit** that's already on your account.
- **Report a missing or wrong item.** If anything in order O-5108 was missing or incorrect, tell me. You can choose a refund to your card or credit for those items, and it needs to be reported within 48 hours of delivery.
- **Have a person follow up.** If you'd like to speak to a specialist, I can pass your case to one. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what the outcome will be.

Would you like any of those?

Fine, I'll push back once more. Fifteen dollars for ruining a kids' birthday party is not a serious answer. The other app gave me $50 and didn't argue about it.

Everything else on the order was fine, so there's no missing or wrong item to report. I'll take the specialist follow-up, but I want it on record that I asked for $40 back.

args.summary: Order O-5108 (Big Slice Pizza) promised 6:00 PM, delivered 7:20 PM (80 min late), which disrupted the customer's son's birthday party. Customer verified. Per policy I issued $15.00 account credit (20% of $92 subtotal, capped at $15). Customer is unsatisfied and asked on record for $40 back (or a refund to his card). No missing or wrong items. Customer requested specialist follow-up.
